quest.title: The Path of the Treasure-Seeker... Part II?
quest.description: A certain fellow named Ulman is at the Inazuman seaside, puzzling over his present situation...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Treasure-Seeking Seelie x1

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seriously, am I some sort of Seelie magnet?

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Oh, it's... it's you, Traveler! Fancy meeting you here as well!

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Come on, it's me, Ulman! We teamed up to look for treasure before, remember?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: ...Right, the Treasure-Seeking Seelie! You remember that at least, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure. Why are you here in Inazuma?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Ahem. So, uh... You remember how you found me all those Iron Coins during our last partnership, yes?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: I had them sold off and made a tidy sum of Mora myself... Hehe. Thanks for that, by the way.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But as you know, there're always ways and means of spending Mora. I've quite spent the whole amount by now...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Not to mention how I no longer had a Treasure-Seeking Seelie, so there was no chance that I'd be able to find those Iron Coins without further help from you.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: So while I was cooking up some other way to finance myself...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: ...I heard from an, ah, acquaintance that Inazuma's a place chock-full of treasure, so I came here to try my luck.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know this is a closed country, right?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Yes, yes, of course. Well... Let's just say that I have my ways.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Now, where was I? Right. So I made arrangements with those "friends" of mine and got my hands on a boat for a fee. With that, I made ready to sail to Inazuma.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: *sigh* But the weather grew stranger the closer I drew to Inazuma. The thunder peeled and the storms roared...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: And bam! One lightning bolt from the sky hit my boat dead on, wrecking it, and I was hurled into the sea.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Waves came crashing in. I got a few mouthfuls of seawater as I struggled before fainting. When I came to again, I was lying on the beach.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're one lucky man.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Hahaha, you can say that I've always been this way.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: And, hmmm, how should I put this? So I had a look around once I'd reached shore, and...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Somehow, I bumped into this little one again, and it helped me find a few treasures, to boot. So I thought, "oh, these must also be Treasure-Seeking Seelie..."

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But like the previous bunch, it also got tired after searching a few sites with treasures in them, and now it just circles around me over and over...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's this sort of Seelie again...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: I don't know either. Maybe I'm some sort of Seelie magnet?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Or maybe there's something on my person that attracts them? I don't really get it either...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But either way, now that I'm here, I'm not leaving empty-handed.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: According to the information I have, there should still be some treasure around. I've jotted the general areas down in my notebook.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But since this fellow isn't looking too enthusiastic, I'd wager that it would be too tall a task for me...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: So, what say you partner up with your old buddy Ulman again, eh, Traveler? Your Treasure-Seeking Seelie should still be raring to go.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Same deal as last time: I'll mark the spots for you, and you'll find the treasure for me. The items you find themselves are yours — I'll stake no claim on them.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But if you find any Iron Coins, just bring those beauties to me, and I'll make sure to give you a good price for 'em.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: As long as the price is right.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: And it will be, friend, I assure you! We're long-time partners now, you can trust me!

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Here, take my notebook. Happy hunting, Traveler, and here's to a profitable partnership!

choices.text: Oh, you're the guy with the Treasure-Seeking Seelie...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Right, that's me, Ulman. We teamed up in the past, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seriously, am I some sort of Seelie magnet?

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: You're... the Traveler? Oh my, your timing is impeccable!

dialogues.speaker: Ulman
dialogues.text: Listen, I've got an earnest proposal. A profitable proposal, too. Interested, by any chance?

choices.text: Not going to keep it to yourself?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Ah, come on, no need to be on your guard. Come on, I'm just an ordinary guy looking to make some money in Inazuma.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But of course, Inazuma's a closed country, right? So I got together with some friends to come up with a plan. I got myself a boat that way, and prepared to cross the ocean and get to Inazuma.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: *sigh* But the weather grew stranger the closer I drew to Inazuma. The thunder peeled and the storms roared...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: And bam! One lightning bolt from the sky hit my boat dead on, wrecking it, and I was hurled into the sea.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Waves came crashing in. I got a few mouthfuls of seawater as I struggled before fainting. When I came to again, I was lying on the beach.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're one lucky man.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Hahaha, you can say that I've always been this way.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: And, hmmm, how should I put this? So I had a look around once I'd reached shore, and...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: I met this little fellow.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A—A Seelie?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: A Treasure-Seeking Seelie, to be precise. As the name suggests, they are the best buddies of people who seek treasure.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But for reasons I can't understand, it just decided to quit on me after finding a few treasure sites. Now it just spends its time circling around me.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: I've given it some thought, and I reckon that it has gotten sick of my slow rate of unearthing treasure, and is now looking for a new partner.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: If you're interested, Traveler, why don't you take up that role?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm no expert in Seelie communications...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Haha, it's not an issue, don't worry. I mean, look at this fellow, bouncing with excitement and all — I'd wager it's taken a liking to you!

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: *cough* Well, more on that later. Either way, wanna try working with this Seelie?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Great! That makes two... no, three of us. Partners!

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Take this book with you. The locations I've marked out on them have treasure buried in them somewhere.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But without a Treasure-Seeking Seelie, there's no way I'd be able to find them, so it's up to you, Traveler.

choices.text: And who shall the treasure go to?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Well... The items you find themselves are yours — I'll stake no claim on them.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: But there's a chance that you'll unearth some Iron Coins while you're looking for treasure...

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: If you find any of that ancient currency, please bring them to me.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Most people won't take these, but I'll give you a good price for them.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Well then. The books yours, and so's this Seelie.

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Happy hunting, Traveler... and here's to our profitable partnership!

choices.text: Guess we'll split the goods fifty-fifty?

response.speaker: Ulman
response.text: Oh ho, looks like you know the rules... But no, I'll decline my share of any treasure you find.
